### NAME

`fierce` - DNS reconnaissance for locating non-contiguous IP space.

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
$ python -m pip install fierce
$ fierce -h
```

```
$ git clone https://github.com/mschwager/fierce.git
$ cd fierce
$ python -m pip install dnspython==1.16.0
$ python fierce/fierce.py -h
```

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

Fierce is a `DNS` reconnaissance tool for locating non-contiguous IP space.
